title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
desc: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, claim to be the owners of a massive company to swindle a business tycoon. To add to their troubles, Gajodhar's brother jumps on to the bandwagon.

title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
desc: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, claim to be the owners of a massive company to swindle a business tycoon. To add to their troubles, Gajodhar's brother jumps on to the bandwagon.

title: Mili
desc: Mili, a young woman, accidentally gets stuck in a walk-in freezer at her workplace. Racing against time, she must find a way to survive.

title: Bhairavakona
desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman fall in love with each other, only to be torn apart by family differences. However, Suman's father is willing to give Prem one last chance where he must prove himself worthy of Suman.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

title: Ghayal
desc: Balwant Rai, a corrupt businessman, frames Ajay for the murder of his brother. Later, with no support from those close to him, Ajay takes an unlikely route to seek revenge.

title: Time Story
desc: Sethuraman, a scientist, invents a time-travelling gadget that his evil twin Athreya wants to get hold of. Soon, a bitter battle arises between Sethuraman's son and Athreya.

title: Ambarsariya
desc: Jatt Ambarsariya, a secret agent, embarks on a mission to save the Home Minister of Punjab from a drug mafia's vicious plans. During his mission, he wins the heart of three pretty ladies.

title: Loafer - The Hero
desc: Raja, a young thief, lives with his father and believes his mother to be dead. However, things become complicated when he comes across Mouni, a runaway girl, and falls for her.

title: Aravind Sametha Veera Raghava
desc: A young man sets out to avenge his father's death but soon realises that violence is not the key to his salvation. His life changes when he meets another man, who helps him rediscover himself.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Annapoorani: The Goddess of Food
desc: Annapoorani, a girl born into an orthodox Hindu family, aspires to become a top chef. However, she faces obstacles that include prejudice and conventional beliefs.

title: Jigarwala No. 1
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Baaghi 4
desc: Following a failed suicide attempt, a man struggles with reality and descends into turmoil. His family faces uncertainty while a concealed truth lures him into a complex maze of obsession and love.

title: Singh Is Kinng
desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.
